Module org.slb4j
Package org.slb4j.handler

Class FileHandler

java.lang.Object
org.slb4j.handler.AbstractFileHandler
org.slb4j.handler.FileHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable, LogHandler, LogPatternConfigurable
public final class FileHandler extends AbstractFileHandler
A log handler that writes log entries to a file. It supports log rotation triggered by file size, number of entries, or time.

      public FileHandler(String name, Path path, boolean append) throws IOException
      Constructs a new FileHandler.
      Parameters:
      name - the name of the handler
      path - the path to the log file
      append - if true, then bytes will be written to the end of the file rather than the beginning
      Throws:
      IOException - if the file cannot be opened

  • Method Details

    • handle

      public void handle(long timestamp, String loggerName, LogLevel lvl, @Nullable String mrk, @Nullable MDC mdc, LocationResolver loc, Supplier<String> msg, @Nullable Throwable t)
      Description copied from interface: LogHandler
      Handles a log entry.
      Parameters:
      timestamp - the timestamp of the log entry (milliseconds since epoch)
      loggerName - the name of the logger
      lvl - the log level of the log entry
      mrk - the marker associated with the log entry, or null if none
      mdc - the MDC associated with the log entry
      loc - the location resolver used to resolve the location of the log entry call site
      msg - the message of the log entry
      t - the throwable associated with the log entry, or null if none
